title: Perfect for endo symptom tracking
body: Intuitive, comprehensive, great interface, easy to check in. I’m really loving the app for comprehensive symptom tracking. I have a lot going on with my body that extends beyond endometriosis and this is helping me have a good picture view and clarity over overlooked symptoms I can share with my doctor.
author: soulsounds

title: Makes life Bearable!
body: First App/tracker I managed to stay on track with, over 30 days.  Amazing.  Hope to get to a financial position to get the paid version soon!
author: MTC19900205

title: Love this app
body: It’s incredibly user friendly and allows me to add anything I want to track. It’s such a relief to be able to track everything in one place and for FREE! So happy I found this app.
author: angy_chloe

title: Perfect Digital Tracker
body:
This app has literally been life-changing. It allows you to track any aspect which may affect your mental/physiological wellbeing. 

Being able to record your mood and physical symptoms paralleled to other factors (medication, sleep, stress, workload etc) gives you a better understanding of self. 

Another user mentioned that the free version of the app gives you access to excellent features; I cannot agree more. I also like that it is very customisable.
author: Zeal1902

title: Exceptional app
body: Bearable is fantastic. Being able to track my symptoms in exactly the amount of detail I choose has been immensely helpful. Being able to track correlations between events/meds/symptoms/lifestyle factors has allowed me to see patterns I wasn’t aware of before, which has really affected how I approach my treatment. Thank you!
author: nudibranchlover
